verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment that teams share collections by exporting and importing JSON files, so collections can exist as text files a developer could commit to git as a manual workaround. The docs describe versioning only inside Postman's cloud workspaces, not native file-based or git-backed storage. Missing for 10: native storage of collections as files in a local repo, documented git integration or sync, first-party docs on collection file format and workflow, and hands-on corroboration.
